title: PlaneMem workbench local work item projections
description: Complete list/detail models for workbench.query operations work_items/work_item; raw and normalized filters, local cursor contents, full records and separate built-in/client envelopes. Standalone source-only prerequisite; no full workbench OpenAPI route coverage claimed.
$comment: Runtime additionally checks UTF-16 length/lone surrogates, finite Date.parse, real UTC dates, int64 decimal maximum, query normalization/equality, unique IDs, returned-filter membership and cursor binding/canonical base64url. Source references/record text are not all control-free. Byte/depth/client work budgets are not generic Gateway guarantees. No validators/generators/runtime verification performed.

id.$comment: Runtime also rejects lone UTF-16 surrogates. Local projection ID, not necessarily ULID/Plane ID; '.' and '..' are not rejected by this parser.

time.description: Finite Date.parse; original text retained, not necessarily canonical UTC. No created<=updated chronology constraint.

date.description: Valid Gregorian date year0001..9999, checked by exact UTC-midnight toISOString roundtrip. due_from inclusive, due_before exclusive; from<before.

positionTime.description: Exact raw database microseconds; calendar checked using millisecond prefix. Never manufacture cursor from displayed milliseconds.

queryText.description: Raw <=500 UTF-16 units and no NUL/lone surrogate; trim to nonempty filter or omit. Other controls/whitespace are not categorically forbidden.

owner.description: Exact nonblank owner text, no trimming/case folding; runtime rejects lone surrogates. Leading/trailing whitespace preserved if nonblank. Not an account-ID lookup.

query.description: Raw shared parser query without operation. Empty optional enum/owner/date fields omitted; query trimmed/omitted; explicit updated_desc normalized to omission. Null rejected. limit defaults25 without insertion; cursor cannot be empty. Unsupplied JS undefined values are not JSON fields.

normalized.description: Captured effective filters, with redundant default/empty values removed. Any nonempty date boundaries must satisfy from<before. Original raw form and this normalized form can share the same query binding.

sourceFields.description: validateSourceRef requires nonempty strings and safe nonnegative revision; no URI syntax/type allowlist/byte/array cap, duplicate or source-existence check.

source.description: Normalized inner source reference; record parser strips extensions. Outer SDK source refs are only validated and preserve extensions.

version.description: Positive local int64 decimal string; runtime BigInt<=9223372036854775807. Not a numeric safe integer, Plane revision, ETag or write precondition.

record.description: Complete normalized local saved row, no scope columns/page-position helper fields. Returned ID equals requested detail ID; no ULID requirement. Raw row/reference extensions stripped. Title/owner/description/trace may be empty and lack parser byte/control limits. Due date can be any finite Date.parse text unless range filtering requires explicit ISO timezone. Original record trace/sources differ from current outer trace/table source.

listFields.description: Page length<=query.limit(default25), IDs unique, rows match status/priority/exact owner/assignment/due conditions. Shared parser does not independently verify text-search membership or sort order. Continuation only on full page and different from incoming cursor; no total count or cross-page snapshot guarantee.

listEnvelope.description: Built-in Gateway wire. One table source and selected request trace; no dedicated HTTP response2MiB cap. Missing/hidden parent yields empty list200, unlike detail404.

clientTrace.description: Exact captured SDK trace, nonblank<=1024 UTF-16/no lone surrogate; SDK does not trim it.

clientList.description: Normalized SDK result. Whole candidate<=2MiB/64depth/100000nodes finite ordinary JSON, exact current trace, closed outer keys. Arbitrary validated outer source refs/extensions preserved; no single postgres-source requirement. Present raw row scope fields must match captured context before stripping.

clientDetail.description: Same strict SDK candidate/trace/closed outer gate; complete detail ID and any supplied raw scope checked. Outer sources may be mock/provider references, with extensions preserved. Does not authorize source URI access.

updatedPosition.description: Decoded production cursor. UTF8 compact JSON canonical unpadded base64url; query hash equality required. Updated DESC, ID ascending using database default ID collation.

duePosition.description: Due ASC NULLS LAST, ID COLLATE C ascending; null position stays in null tail. Exact canonical base64url and bound query hash; not compatible with default position or Mock cursor.

x-runtime-boundaries.http: Both operations use authenticated workbench POST, context.read Policy/audit and generic actor/path limiter; no dedicated verified-client gate. Optional expected actor/client headers checked. Pre-auth generic1MiB JSON, traceparent before x-trace-id. Unknown body keys400. URL query/media/encoding/cache conditions not specifically rejected; no write-header preconditions or cached original result. No dedicated2MiB server response cap or two-slot handler.
x-runtime-boundaries.filter: All scoped visible undeleted rows and parent project visibility filtered before LIMIT+1. Nonrestricted capability excludes restricted row and parent. query is case-insensitive literal substring over external_id/title/owner using strpos(lower(concat_ws)); '%'/'_' are literal, description excluded. Exact owner uses C equality. assigned means owner!='', including whitespace-only saved owners; unassigned means ''. Dates apply UTC inclusive lower/exclusive upper, no wall-clock overdue inference or automatic removal of terminal statuses.
x-runtime-boundaries.paging: Default updated_at DESC/id ASC uses original default DB collation; due_asc uses due_at ASC NULLS LAST/id COLLATE C. SQL raw microseconds form cursor, not displayed timestamps. SHA256 key binds scope/restricted visibility/normalized filters; v1 default query+status, v2 priority/owner, v3 assignment, v4 due/range, v5 due_asc. Limit/trace/actor/client absent from key, so limit may change; current auth always reapplied. New filter/sort requires first page. Cursor is opaque continuation, not signature/authority; no stable cross-request snapshot.
x-runtime-boundaries.result: Built-in Date objects converted toISOString for row fields; raw strings retained. Version bigint cast to text. Source extensions stripped, all saved fields validated, whole malformed page fails500 without client shrinking. Shared parser checks returned categorical/date filters but not query substring/order. Date range requires saved date with explicit Z/numeric offset; no local-time interpretation. Default encoder has less position validation than due encoder; incoming cursor always fully decoded/calendar/canonical checked.
x-runtime-boundaries.sdk: Dedicated readWorkItems/readWorkItem capture own data-property flat query/options and context, normalize before send, detach JSON request<=8KiB. Default30s per-request budget begins after capture and includes custom transport/full candidate parse; synchronous work checked afterwards. Fetch separately default30s includes credential/network/body; exact200/trace/media, fatal UTF8, decoded success2MiB/error16KiB and content-length rules. No automatic retry or writes; known same-trace errors become finite messages and retryable=false, others GATEWAY_UNAVAILABLE. Ordinary overview does not share these stronger transport rules.
x-runtime-boundaries.iterator: workItemPages captures query/context immediately, no timer/request until next(). One page per demand; default100/max1000 pages, separate budget per page, no total iteration deadline. Retains continuation privately before yielding mutable page; detects repeated cursor before yielding offending page. Limit reached only errors when further next requested with pending continuation. No prefetch/save/cross-page deduplication or snapshot.
x-runtime-boundaries.errors: INVALID_JSON/INVALID_INPUT400 false, initial auth401/403, detail WORK_ITEM_NOT_FOUND404 false; hidden parent list returns empty200. RATE_LIMITED429 true; WORK_ITEM_PROJECTION_INVALID500 false; unexpected INTERNAL_ERROR500 true; WORKBENCH_DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE/WORKBENCH_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE/AUDIT_PERSISTENCE_UNAVAILABLE503 true. SDK sanitizes trusted same-trace errors to retryable=false and does not expose original details.
x-runtime-boundaries.mock: MockWorkItemStore has explicit visible seed/authorization and independent cursor formats/ordering. Returns mock-work-item-store source, not postgres. SDK accepts that source shape; no production/Mock cursor interchangeability or machine-schema integration claimed.
